summary: Backend + mobile-web UI regression completed for colorful-3d-v3 category refresh. APIs return 12 categories with colorful-3d-v3 illustration paths, and 12+all category-media endpoints return decodable WebP. Home/Topics/Onboarding/Reader smoke flows pass with real image rendering and expected topic toggle behavior.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated warnings still emitted: props.pointerEvents and textShadow* style props.

action_items: Optional cleanup: replace deprecated RN-web style usage (pointerEvents prop and textShadow* props) to remove console warnings.
No functional fix required for requested artwork/category scope based on this run.
critical_code_review_comments: category-artwork/category-grid/home-controls keep testIDs and correctly gate placeholder fallback until image load.
No hardcoded localhost usage found in the tested category art flow; API requests use configured BASE URL.
Light theme keeps dark art tiles intentionally; labels remained visible in Topics validation screenshot.

success_rate.frontend: 96% (all requested functional checks passed; one intermediate script assertion was invalid test assumption and corrected in follow-up)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on public preview URL only. Topics grid verified at 390 and 320 widths with 3 columns and no horizontal overflow. Images were verified as real rendered assets (not fallback line icons) on Home, Topics, and Onboarding topic picker.
rca_of_issue: Intermediate UI failure was caused by test assumption (expecting Animali tile always visible on Discover after interests persisted to a single category), not a product defect. Follow-up light-theme validation on Topics passed with visible labels and loaded images.
